newsitem.title: SPAIN: Govt to sell Gas Natural stake within 2 wks.
newsitem.headline: Govt to sell Gas Natural stake within 2 wks.

text.p: The share offering of the Spanish government's 3.8 percent stake in energy group Gas Natural will take place during the next fortnight, market sources told Reuters on Monday.
The institutional offering will be confirmed by the Stock Exchange Commission CNMV later this week, and the institutions will make their bids the following week.
"If the prospectus is verified by the CNMV this week, from 25-30 November the road show will take place," a source at state holding company SEPI said.
In the first week of December, the placement price will be fixed and the shares will be allocated the following day.
The market is expecting the price to be fixed on December 2, sources said.
At closing prices today, 3.8 percent of Gas Natural would be worth 35.35 billion pesetas.
Sixty percent of the offer is aimed at domestic investors, with the remaining 40 percent aimed to international buyers.
The domestic tranche is to be lead-managed by BBV Interactivos and the international tranche by Warburg.
Co-managers are Banco Bilbao Vizcaya and Catalan savings bank La Caixa.

Argentaria, Banco Santander, Banco Central Hispano and Cajamadrid are underwriters for the domestic segment, while for the international tranche SBC Warburg, Paribas and Merrill Lynch will perform the same function.
Market sources also said that once this sale is over, the government imminently plans to sell its nine percent stake in Enagas to Gas Natural, making the latter its full owner.
